headline: Singapore Hikes 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to Around 6%
summary: Singapore raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to around 6%, but projected growth to moderate between 2.5% and 4.5% in 2027 as global artificial intelligence capital expenditure eases.
why: Singapore serves as a global bellwether for international trade, electronics exports, and financial flows across Southeast Asia.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Official 2026 GDP projections were upgraded toward 6% on strong electronics and trade performance.
